title: Examining Gender and Racial Bias in Large Vision–Language Models Using a Novel Dataset of Parallel Images

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) responses to multiple-choice questions about occupations using a dataset of parallel AI-generated images of men and women, alongside Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) lexical analysis of open-ended image descriptions and stories.

Comparing LVLM responses to multiple-choice questions regarding social status and criminality using parallel AI-generated images of Black and white individuals, combined with Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) word association analysis on open-ended text generation tasks.
